scientific_question: Does the fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons surrounded by multiple nearby reactive astrocytes capture a stronger memory-decline signal than the current CA1 reactive-astro niche summaries?
approach: Assign cells to CA1 using CustomAnnotations polygons after dividing polygon coordinates by 16. From ClassificationNode labels, select CA1 Pyramidal Neurons and CA1 Reactive Astrocytes. Build a spatial index on CA1 reactive astrocyte centroids. For each CA1 pyramidal neuron, count reactive astrocytes within a fixed Euclidean radius of 60 px. The donor-level biomarker is the fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons whose nearby reactive astrocyte count meets or exceeds threshold k. If CA1 pyramidal neurons are absent, return NaN; if reactive astrocytes are absent but pyramidal neurons are present, return 0.

variations.name: encirclement_k2_60px
variations.description: Baseline: fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 2 reactive astrocytes within 60 px.

variations.name: encirclement_k3_60px
variations.description: Stricter threshold: fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 3 reactive astrocytes within 60 px.

variations.name: encirclement_k4_60px
variations.description: High-burden threshold: fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 4 reactive astrocytes within 60 px.

notes: Use centroid coordinates only; no contour math is needed. Keep the radius in raw cell-coordinate pixels, matching prior 60 px neighborhood work. Region polygons are at 16x cell coordinates, so divide by 16 before point-in-polygon assignment. Restrict both source and target cells to CA1 before neighbor counting. A KD-tree or ball query is sufficient and auditable.
rationale: The accepted panel has improved monotonically by moving from broad CA1 composition to more localized pyramidal-reactive astrocyte niche features, but the last gain from a coverage summary was small. The right next test is a neuron-centric severity measure: not just whether reactive astrocytes are present near pyramidal neurons, but whether a donor has many pyramidal neurons with multi-astrocyte encirclement, which could add signal or replace a weaker niche/coverage member with a cleaner perineuronal burden metric.
